source.rule: Only deployments carrying services.decentralized-network.query-id. Messari's hosted-service endpoints died with The Graph hosted-service shutdown.

excludedSchemas.governance: Governance data has no role in a fixed-income mandate.
excludedSchemas.yield-aggregator: Yield routing, not a direct yield source the mandate allocates to.

excludedSchemas.erc721: Bare NFT metadata; no protocol or yield surface.
